title: A formula field that reads through a reference (`record.book.title`) passes validateExpression, then reads null on every row: the read path projects only the row's own columns
body:
## Source

Read on the framework pin cloud consumes (`.objectstack-sha` `be076dad28a0`, frozen tree), while the `repo:cloud#2` seat checked the premise of objectstack-ai/cloud#2925 before dispatch. That card asks the AI builder to point a junction object's `nameField` at a formula composed from its two lookups' titles (「{图书} · {读者} · {借出日期}」). ADR-0079 D3 prescribes a text formula as the composite-title mechanism. Nothing tells an author that such a formula cannot read the other side.

## What happens

1. **Authoring accepts it.** `@objectstack/formula`'s `validateExpression('value', "record.book.title + ' · ' + record.reader.name", { objectName: 'loan', fields, fieldTypes: { book: 'lookup', reader: 'lookup', … }, scope: 'record' })` answers 0 errors and 0 warnings at the pin. This was measured by a probe against the pin's `packages/formula/dist`.
   - The lint's formula pass (`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`, `judgeFieldFormula`, about line 2720) calls it with no `traversalHydration`.
   - The #20078 refusal of a read through a reference covers `FieldTraversalSlot = 'requiredWhen' | 'readonlyWhen' | 'option visibleWhen'` only (line 1190). A field `expression` is not in it.
2. **The read path cannot honour it.**
   - `planFormulaProjection` (`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`, about line 1690) projects this object's own stored columns for a formula. A reference column holds an id, so `record.book.title` meets a string.
   - Only the validation-rule path pins one hop before evaluating (`packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts` with `analyzeRelationshipTraversals`).
   - The read writes `null` for the field and reports the fault to the sink (`engine.ts`, about line 2603, #22019). That happens on every row.
3. **Consequence for a title:** a formula `nameField` written this way shows no title on any record. An AI that follows ADR-0079 D3 literally for a junction object (a loan, a booking, an enrolment) produces it.

## Declared ≠ enforced

The expression is accepted where it is declared and never honoured where it runs. This is the same shape #20078 closed for field-level predicates. Which direction closes it is the open question on objectstack-ai/cloud#2925 (its decision analysis follows on that card):
- **(a)** the formula read path pins one hop the way validation rules do, so the expression works;
- **(b)** the formula pass refuses a read through a reference loudly, with the prescription that names the alternative.

Either way, today's silent null goes.

## Reach

Any formula field (not only a `nameField`) whose expression names `record.<lookup>.<field>`. The AI builder in cloud is a producer: its prompt tells the model to compose titles as formulas (`blueprint-tools.ts`, the `nameField` rule).

## Dedupe

Read: #20078 (the predicate slots, closed), #22019 (unregistered function → null, closed), #20082 (`can()` in a formula, closed), #6674 (formula in `searchableFields`, closed). None covers a formula `expression` read through a reference.

<sub>Filed by the `repo:cloud#2` seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#24145, session `session_01Cbdek8SKSHxddGqTPZXdqX`). ⛔ Not a claim.</sub>
